signal: Minitab rolled out AI-powered tools across its analytics suite and was named to the G2 2026 Best Software Awards for Best Data Analytics Software.

email.body1:
Frank, saw Minitab rolled AI across the analytics suite and just landed on the G2 2026 Best Software list.

A wave of AI launches plus that recognition usually means more in-market accounts in play than an Americas team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Frank, quick follow-up for Minitab.

New AI features and awards expand the buyers worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the Americas book needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Frank, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab reply rate likely compares to other analytics vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Frank, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Americas coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your Americas motion? I will tailor it to Minitab either way.
